title: Worse Overall, in Three Dimensions
eyebrow: CETI · the 75-second case · Simpson's paradox · draft B, the exhibit
lede: A new sales process converts worse overall, so it gets killed. Berkeley 1973 as a gallery: two sculptures of 4,526 boxes, one box per applicant. Walk the camera around them and the same boxes read the other way.

commit.title: YOUR GUESS
commit.prompt: Women got in less often overall. In how many of the 6 departments did they do worse?

captions: Our new sales process converts worse overall.
So we killed it. Case closed?
Berkeley, 1973: women got in less often overall.
In how many of 6 departments did women do worse?
Fewer women got in. The headline writes itself.
Overall: 45 % of men admitted, 30 % of women.
Now unstack the same boxes by department.
Same boxes, same rules. Compare each department.
Women did worse in 2 of 6, and ahead in 4.
Monday: did the new process get the same mix of leads?
Splitting explains this gap. It does not prove fairness.

brand.takeaway: Worse overall can be better in most parts. Split first.

sources: Bickel, P. J., Hammel, E. A., & O'Connell, J. W. (1975). Sex bias in graduate admissions: Data from Berkeley. Science, 187(4175), 398–404. doi:10.1126/science.187.4175.398
R Core Team. UCBAdmissions: Student Admissions at UC Berkeley (R datasets package; 4,526 applicants, six largest departments, 1973; counts from Bickel et al. 1975).
Freedman, D., Pisani, R., & Purves, R. (2007). Statistics (4th ed.), ch. 2 §4: the six largest majors, Berkeley 1973. W. W. Norton.
Simpson, E. H. (1951). The interpretation of interaction in contingency tables. Journal of the Royal Statistical Society, Series B, 13(2), 238–241.
Pearl, J. (2014). Comment: Understanding Simpson's paradox. The American Statistician, 68(1), 8–13. doi:10.1080/00031305.2014.876829
factory/FORMAT.md and docs/DECISIONS.md Q13: the 8-second commit hold and the film-mode default guess (5).
honest: Six departments of one year, split once: it explains this gap and does not prove fairness, and it cannot say why women applied mostly to the crowded departments.

knobs_doc.name: camFrontAz
knobs_doc.what: azimuth (deg) of the front view held while the towers build; 0 = square on, positive = from the viewer's right

knobs_doc.name: camFrontEl
knobs_doc.what: elevation (deg) of the front view; low = monumental, high = plan-like

knobs_doc.name: camFrontDist
knobs_doc.what: distance (units) of the front view; smaller = the towers fill more of the frame

knobs_doc.name: camHookDist
knobs_doc.what: distance at t = 0; the HOOK pulls back from here (close on the two pads) toward the front view

knobs_doc.name: camSideAz
knobs_doc.what: azimuth (deg) of the rail view; 90 = square on to the department row

knobs_doc.name: camSideEl
knobs_doc.what: elevation (deg) of the rail view

knobs_doc.name: camSideDist
knobs_doc.what: distance (units) of the tracking shot along the rail; smaller = one pair fills the frame

knobs_doc.name: camWideDist
knobs_doc.what: distance (units) of the pull-back that shows all six pairs (the reveal frame)

knobs_doc.name: camFov
knobs_doc.what: vertical field of view (radians); larger = more depth, more distortion

knobs_doc.name: tHookEnd
knobs_doc.what: time (s) at which the HOOK push-in ends

knobs_doc.name: tDollyStart
knobs_doc.what: time (s) the dolly from the front view to the side starts (the towers start to unstack here)

knobs_doc.name: tDollyEnd
knobs_doc.what: time (s) the dolly arrives beside pair A

knobs_doc.name: trackStart
knobs_doc.what: time (s) the camera leaves pair A along the rail

knobs_doc.name: pairStep
knobs_doc.what: seconds per department pair along the rail (dolly speed along the rail = slabGap / pairStep)

knobs_doc.name: pairHold
knobs_doc.what: seconds the camera rests on each pair before sliding on (must be below pairStep)

knobs_doc.name: tWide
knobs_doc.what: time (s) the camera starts to pull back from pair F

knobs_doc.name: tWideEnd
knobs_doc.what: time (s) the pull-back lands on the wide shot

knobs_doc.name: dollyEase
knobs_doc.what: easing of the front-to-side dolly: quad, cubic, sine, expo

knobs_doc.name: morphDur
knobs_doc.what: seconds one headline number takes to morph into the next

knobs_doc.name: morphLead
knobs_doc.what: seconds before the camera arrives at a pair that its headline numbers start to morph

knobs_doc.name: lightAz
knobs_doc.what: azimuth (deg) of the key light, 0 = from the front, 90 = from the right side

knobs_doc.name: lightEl
knobs_doc.what: elevation (deg) of the key light

knobs_doc.name: lightReach
knobs_doc.what: distance (units) at which the key light has fallen to half; smaller = a tighter pool

knobs_doc.name: keyStrength
knobs_doc.what: brightness of the key light

knobs_doc.name: ambient
knobs_doc.what: ambient fill; 0 = the shadow side is black

knobs_doc.name: fogDensity
knobs_doc.what: depth fog toward the background colour

knobs_doc.name: reflect
knobs_doc.what: strength of the floor reflection; 0 turns it off (and its draw cost)

knobs_doc.name: roomSize
knobs_doc.what: distance (units) from the centre to the back and side walls

knobs_doc.name: boxSize
knobs_doc.what: edge of a box in a 10-unit cell; the gap between boxes is 10 minus this

knobs_doc.name: slabGap
knobs_doc.what: pitch (units) between department pairs along the rail; the gap between slabs is this minus 132

knobs_doc.name: towerX
knobs_doc.what: x of each pooled tower from the centre line

knobs_doc.name: splitX
knobs_doc.what: x of the men's and women's columns after the unstack

knobs_doc.name: liftArc
knobs_doc.what: height (units) of the hop each slab makes while the towers unstack

knobs_doc.name: railX
knobs_doc.what: x of the rail the camera rides (a thin lit track on the floor)

knobs_doc.name: tBuild0
knobs_doc.what: time (s) the towers start to rise

knobs_doc.name: buildRate
knobs_doc.what: layers per second while the towers rise (same for both, so the men's column ends taller)

knobs_doc.name: tAdmit0
knobs_doc.what: time (s) the admitted boxes start to light, bottom to top

knobs_doc.name: tAdmitDur
knobs_doc.what: seconds the admit light takes to climb the towers

knobs_doc.name: glowStrength
knobs_doc.what: emissive strength of the admitted boxes

knobs_doc.name: tUnstack0
knobs_doc.what: time (s) department A starts to lift off the tower; keep equal to tDollyStart

knobs_doc.name: unstackStagger
knobs_doc.what: seconds between departments lifting off

knobs_doc.name: unstackDur
knobs_doc.what: seconds one slab takes to hop to its place

knobs_doc.name: headSize
knobs_doc.what: cap height (units) of the headline numbers

knobs_doc.name: headX
knobs_doc.what: inset (units) of the headline numbers from the left and right edges

knobs_doc.name: headY
knobs_doc.what: top (units) of the headline numbers

knobs_doc.name: tReveal
knobs_doc.what: time (s) of the reveal: the higher column of each pair glows, the tally and YOU/TRUTH appear

knobs_doc.name: neonStrength
knobs_doc.what: neon post strength on the reveal frames only; 0 turns the post off

knobs_doc.name: neonRadius
knobs_doc.what: neon glow reach (units of the 960 sheet)

knobs_doc.name: neonThresh
knobs_doc.what: brightness above which a pixel glows

knobs_doc.name: neonCore
knobs_doc.what: white-hot core of the neon

knobs_doc.name: neonT0
knobs_doc.what: time (s) the neon post fades in

knobs_doc.name: neonT1
knobs_doc.what: time (s) the neon post is gone
